Select IC50 activities for human Aurora kinase A. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'Aurora kinase A' and organism 'Homo sapiens', standard_type 'IC50', and require both canonical_smiles and a literature reference (pubmed_id or doi). Return molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
